query_text: Create a ranked horizontal bar chart showing the top 12 countries by `leaderboard capture ratio`, where the metric is `the sum of scores from country-list companies that also appear in at least one main-industry top-20 table divided by that country's visible total score`, values are percentages, countries must have at least 5 visible companies in their country table, and bars are sorted descending after the cross-view match is completed.
sort_rule: descending by leaderboard_capture_ratio_percent, ties by overlap_score_total then country
selection_rule: top 12 eligible countries with at least 5 visible companies

plot_spec.title: Country Leaderboard Capture Ratio
plot_spec.xlabel: Percent of visible country score matched to main-industry leaders
